config._strike_policy_doc: The held patch MULTIPLIES flash by the strike level (patch hunk Evaluate: 'Gated by any strike'). Every P01 score lamp strikes at 6.5-47 m, so a lamp 15-45 m ahead is unstruck and its flash would be invisible. flash_owns writes strike_on_approach=false on the chosen lamps (lighting_events_apply.py phase_b_drama precedent); keep leaves strike on and the plan REFUSES any flash beyond the lamp's strike distance (FLASH_GATED_BY_STRIKE).
